an3.37:1.1: In [dn32](), the four great kings are named as Dhataraṭṭha lord of centaurs in the east, Virūḷha lord of gnomes in the south, Virūpakkha lord of dragons in the west, and Kuvera Vessavaṇa lord of native spirits in the north.
an3.37:1.2: _Paṭijāgaronti_ (= BHSK _pratijāgarti_) means “to wakefully watch over”, i.e. “keep vigil”. In the Buddhist tradition of north-east Thailand in which I ordained, it is still a common practice to remain awake the whole night for the _uposatha_.
